island_of_enigmas.name: Island of Enigmas
island_of_enigmas.description: A mysterious island with ancient ruins and secret pathways.
island_of_enigmas.image_prompt: mysterious island at sea, foggy night

shipwreck.name: Shipwreck
shipwreck.description: The ship that crashed near the island. Alden knows where it is from the map he found.

ancient_map.name: Ancient Map
ancient_map.description: A detailed map of the islands and their secrets. It reveals where the treasure chest is hidden.

treasure_chest_unlocked.name: Treasure Chest (Unlocked)
treasure_chest_unlocked.description: The chest is now unlocked, revealing its contents. This chest contains valuable artifacts and clues to the island's mysteries.
treasure_chest_unlocked.image_prompt: open treasure chest with various objects inside

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A brave young adventurer in search of the hidden treasure. He has a map showing the path to the island and is ready for an adventure.

siren_queen.name: Queen Sirena
siren_queen.description: The siren queen who guards the ancient ruins on the island. She is known for her beautiful voice and deadly music.
siren_queen.image_prompt: sexy sirens with golden hair, underwater kingdom

dialogues.before_talk: Siren: I have heard your bravery in the name of the village... may we make a deal? You get the treasure... but only if you sing for me.
dialogues.after_talk: Queen Sirena: Your voice is not good enough. Sing again!...
dialogues.after_satisfied: Queen Sirena: Good, you have won my trust. You can pass this island, but beware of those who try to take what does not belong to them.
dialogues.hostile: Queen Sirena: You insolent human! I will make sure you don't get any closer.
